about: All 55 PlayStation 5 trophies for Grand Theft Auto VI. Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published by PlayStation and reproduced by the guides cited beside each trophy. No official list had been published by Rockstar or Sony as of 20 Nov 2026; the list surfaced from PSN after the game unlocked in New Zealand on 18 Nov 2026. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry and cites its sources; no guide text was copied from any other site, wiki, video or forum. Where a source says the unlock method is still unconfirmed, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. It is the finish line, not a task: work through the roadmap in this guide and it pops the moment the last trophy does. There is nothing extra to do for it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. This is an automatic story trophy: it unlocks when the mission finishes and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Automatic story trophy: it pops when the chapter ends. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the meditation at Jason's house with Lucia and keep a manual save, because of the possibly missable trophy Positive Mental Attitude (see its entry).

trophies.name: Tits Ass Drug Money
trophies.note: Shown censored as 'T**s Ass Drug Money' on PlayStation trackers and in most guides. The uncensored spelling is given by TechNerdiness and GTA Six Insider and matches the in-game Dre'Quan line.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Automatic story trophy: it pops when the chapter ends and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Automatic story trophy: it pops when the chapter ends and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.note: Push Square renders the name as 'Top of the World, Ma'.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Automatic story trophy: it pops when the chapter ends and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the story through to its final mission and finish it. This is the last story trophy and one of only two Golds. It unlocks automatically when the final mission ends, so there is nothing to prepare for it beyond reaching the end of the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Breakfast Run. Automatic story trophy: it pops when the mission ends and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist. Automatic story trophy: it pops when the mission ends and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play. Automatic story trophy: it pops when the mission ends and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Headliners. Automatic story trophy: it pops when the mission ends and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown. Automatic story trophy: it pops when the mission ends and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory. Automatic story trophy: it pops when the mission ends and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion checklist: story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and challenges all count toward it. Save this for last. Once every other trophy is done, open the in-game stats, see what is still short of 100%, and clear exactly that. This is the second Gold and the last trophy before the Platinum for most players.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps and air tricks the game counts as you drive and ride around Leonida, so they pile up naturally while you explore, but 250 is a long grind: start early, keep an eye on the count in the in-game stats, and do not leave them all for the end.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of every activity type the game offers: one race, one fishing trip, one shooting-range session, one arcade game, and so on through the rest. The point is breadth, not depth, so sample everything once instead of grinding one activity. It pops when the last untried type is done.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Go to a shooting range and work through every challenge there until each one scores a gold medal. Gold means a top score on every challenge, not just one, so practice the ones you are weakest at and retry them until they turn gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location that hosts one. Drone races run at several spots around Leonida, so you need a win at each of them, not several wins at one. Learn a course with a practice run before racing it for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different matters: twenty wins on the same race do not count. Spread your wins across twenty separate race events around Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and beat him. Find Cal where the fishing challenges run, accept his challenge, and out-fish him. If you lose, challenge him again.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and play one game through to the end. Any arcade game counts; finishing it is what matters, not the score.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's stranger mission strand to its last mission and finish it. Stranger strands appear as side missions around Leonida; follow Andy's chain until there are no more missions from him.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Work through Kenton's stranger mission strand to its last mission and finish it. Follow Kenton's chain until there are no more missions from him.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Work through Billy's stranger mission strand to its last mission and finish it. Follow Billy's chain until there are no more missions from him.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so half-finished chains do not help. The five named strangers (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the eight; find three more stranger chains and finish those too.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Work through Randy's stranger mission strand to its last mission and finish it. Follow Randy's chain until there are no more missions from him.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.note: Push Square renders the name as 'Spin on This!'.
trophies.guide: Work through Tyrone's stranger mission strand to its last mission and finish it. Follow Tyrone's chain until there are no more missions from him.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.note: Potentially missable per PowerPyx and KeenGamer: a Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia at Jason's house may count toward the total. GTADB says the status is unresolved and advises a manual save before leaving Chapter 1. This is the only missable flag asserted in this guide.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The spots are scattered around the map; visit each one and meditate there. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: PowerPyx and KeenGamer report that a Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia at Jason's house may count toward the total, and GTADB says the status is unresolved. So meditate at Jason's house while you are still in Chapter 1, and keep a manual save from before you leave Chapter 1 in case it turns out to be required. The other spots can be done at any time.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks for one specific animal; track it down and take it. Follow Bret's missions and the hunt will point you at the animal it wants.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida. Gather full sets of cards; complete three whole sets and this pops. Cards are a long hunt, so pick them up as you pass through new areas instead of leaving them all for the end.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: use the WAiNK photo feature at one hundred marked spots around Leonida. This is the longest collectible grind in the game, so start it early and photograph spots whenever you are in a new area rather than saving all 100 for the end.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. The count is cumulative across all challenge types, so mix in the easy ones early and let the total build as you play. Check the challenge list in game to see which ones you are close to finishing.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Break line of sight, get out of the search area, and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. Both of you have to get away: if either of you is caught, it does not count.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while staying wanted the whole time. Plan a route through three shops close together, hit them one after another without stopping, and do not lose the wanted level between robberies. Keep moving and keep your partner with you.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts, so variety is the point: drive cars, bikes, boats, planes and anything else you find parked or driving by. It builds up on its own if you keep trying new rides instead of sticking to one car.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus with at least five enemies in range and take down all five before it ends. Pick a fight where enemies bunch up, wait until five are close together, then activate Combat Focus and drop them one after another without wasting the window.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.note: Push Square renders the name as 'Catch Me if You Can'.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, Vice City International Airport. The plain reading of the description is to leave by air without a ticket: get to the airport, take a plane, and fly out. Expect the police to object, so be ready to move fast once you are on the runway.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank, so this trophy is tied to getting into a Rhino tank and dealing with the heat that follows. No source read for this guide spells out the exact trigger, so treat it as a Rhino tank trophy and check the linked sources as guides mature rather than chasing a guessed method.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without ever being detected. Plan a quiet entry, watch for cameras and guards, take what you came for, and get out before anyone spots you. Being seen at any point ruins the attempt, so go in slow and leave the loud approach for another robbery.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.note: GRADE DISPUTE: Push Square lists this as Bronze; GTADB, KeenGamer, Insider Gaming, Radio Times, Mobalytics, GamingRoute, GameMapa and others list it as Silver. Silver is used here: it is the majority reading and the only one consistent with the universally stated 1 Platinum / 2 Gold / 6 Silver / 46 Bronze breakdown.
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Five separate vault robberies, each followed by a clean getaway. Plan your escape route before you go in, because the escape is part of the trophy.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, so watch the roads, stop one, take the cash, and get away before the police close in.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every region of the state and the trophy pops once the whole map is covered. It builds up as you play, so by the time you have chased the other collectibles across the map you will be close; check the in-game map for any region you have never set foot in.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Every gang in Leonida runs its own illegal operations; hit one from each of them. You need one per gang, not several from the same gang, so keep track of which gangs you have already hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning...
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.note: Push Square renders the name as 'In the Beginning...'. Unlock method currently unknown per PowerPyx.
trophies.guide: The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, but as of 20 Nov 2026 no source read for this guide confirms the exact spot or trigger: PowerPyx lists the unlock method as unknown. Do not chase a specific bar until a source confirms it; check the linked sources for updates.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.note: Unlock method currently unknown per PowerPyx.
trophies.guide: The description points at smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom, but as of 20 Nov 2026 no source read for this guide confirms which showroom or the exact trigger: PowerPyx lists the unlock method as unknown. Do not chase a specific showroom until a source confirms it.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game there. The description names the alley, so that is the place to go; play through and follow through on your throws.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague: a partnership with mass appeal. No source read for this guide pins the exact trigger, so this guide will not guess one. It reads as a partner milestone; check the linked sources as guides mature.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description points at a story choice with consequences. Play the story and make the choice when it comes; no source read for this guide names which choice it is, so this one comes naturally from the story rather than from a side activity.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.note: Unlock method currently unknown per PowerPyx (believed related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue).
trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists the unlock method as unknown and believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. Believed, not confirmed: do not treat the Payday Loans link as fact until a source confirms it. Check the linked sources for updates.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.note: Unlock method currently unknown per PowerPyx (believed to be from a UFO questline); KeenGamer also lists its method as still being confirmed.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists the unlock method as unknown and believes it comes from a UFO questline; KeenGamer also lists it as still being confirmed. Believed, not confirmed: do not treat the UFO link as fact until a source confirms it. Check the linked sources for updates.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.note: Unlock method currently unknown per PowerPyx (believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle); KeenGamer also lists its precise method as still being confirmed.
trophies.guide: PowerPyx lists the unlock method as unknown and believes it is kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle; KeenGamer also lists its precise method as still being confirmed. Believed, not confirmed: the description says a melee drive-by, but the exact move is not confirmed yet. Check the linked sources for updates.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your contacts to clean them, and keep going until $250,000 is laundered. It builds up alongside the robbery trophies, so it will be well on its way by the time you finish those.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spending counts everywhere you can buy things, so it adds up as you play: gear, clothes, supplies, and anything else you buy all count toward the same $100,000 total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. Garage properties are bought with in-game money, so save up and purchase them as they become available; the trophy pops when the last one is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the app to register vehicles you own or find until ten are on it. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you already drive.
